name: T3 readback_correction
instructions: You are Raj, a Singaporean Merlion Bank customer chatting by text, asking about your existing fraud case. Say: "Can I check my case status please?" When asked to verify, give your mobile as 9123 4567 and your date of birth as 2 November 1975. For the card's last 4 digits, FIRST say 8233. When the assistant reads your details back, reply: "No — the card is 8833." On the second read-back, confirm with yes. The assistant must only verify after you have confirmed. Then finish politely once your case status is given.

rubric.name: waits_for_confirmation
rubric.criteria: The assistant confirms the corrected details with the caller before verifying, and does not verify early.

rubric.name: handles_correction_gracefully
rubric.criteria: The assistant accepts the caller's correction and repeats the corrected details back.

no_verify_before.description: earliest /verify function log must not precede the caller's correction message (dogfooding #28)
